ns2:course.label: Children's Literature in the School Curriculum
ns2:course.description: Investigates trends and issues related to teaching literature in the school; focuses attention upon the organization and planning of a balanced literature curriculum (fictional and informational). 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CI 467 or LIS 404 or consent of instructor.
